title: 30A Pontoon Rental
specs: Is alcohol allowed on the boat?
Alcohol is allowed on the boat.
However, we do not tolerate any alcohol used by the driver.

Please know, it is against Florida law to drive a boat while under the influence of alcohol. (We can also add a driver to your rental for an additional fee if you’d prefer not to designate a driver.) Are pets allowed on the boats?
Only one waiver needs to be signed by each driver of each vessel but must be signed prior to launch.
Please note the following important info for your booking: We use a public boat dock and must be courteous to fellow boaters.
Alcohol is allowed on the boat, however, no glass allowed.
